【適應症】解熱、鎮痛。用於感冒引起的發燒、頭痛、關節痛、神經痛及牙痛。

【用法用量】
成人及十二歲以上：每次一至二錠，每日三至四次。
兒童六至十二歲：每次半錠至一錠，每日三次。
六歲以下：請諮詢醫師。

【注意事項】
• 服藥後如有過敏症狀，請立即停藥並就醫。
• 肝功能不佳者請在醫師指導下使用。
• 請放在兒童不易取得處。
• 避免同時服用含有乙醯氨酚的其他藥物。

title: 龜兔賽跑
description: Classic fable: The Tortoise and the Hare
text_zh:
從前，有一隻兔子和一隻烏龜，牠們決定比賽跑步。兔子跑得很快，一下子就跑到了前面，覺得自己一定會贏，便在樹下睡著了。烏龜雖然跑得很慢，但牠一直努力不停地往前走。等兔子醒來的時候，烏龜已經到達終點了。比賽的結果讓大家都很驚訝。

這個故事告訴我們：謙虛努力的人，比驕傲懶惰的人更容易成功。

cóng qián ， yǒu yī zhī tù zi hé yī zhī wū guī ， tā men jué dìng bǐ sài pǎo bù 。 tù zi pǎo dé hěn kuài ， yī xià zi jiù pǎo dào le qián miàn ， jué dé zì jǐ yī dìng huì yíng ， biàn zài shù xià shuì zhù le 。 wū guī suī rán pǎo dé hěn màn ， dàn tā yī zhí nǔ lì bù tíng dì wǎng qián zǒu 。 děng tù zi xǐng lái de shí hòu ， wū guī yǐ jīng dào dá zhōng diǎn le 。 bǐ sài de jié guǒ ràng dà jiā dōu hěn jīng yà 。

text_en: The Tortoise and the Hare is a classic Aesop's fable. Once upon a time, a hare challenged a tortoise to a race. The hare ran very fast, so he became proud and took a nap along the way. The tortoise moved slowly but steadily, never stopping. In the end, the tortoise crossed the finish line before the hare. This story tells us that persistence and hard work are more important than natural talent.

提醒：週日外出請攜帶雨具，注意安全。山區民眾請注意山崩及土石流風險。

text_pinyin: Táiběi jiéyùn yǒu hěnduō xiàn. Hóngsè shì Dànshuǐ Xìnyì xiàn, lánsè shì Bǎnnán xiàn. Rúguǒ nǐ yào qù Táiběi yī-líng-yī, qǐng dāchéng hóngxiàn. Rúguǒ nǐ yào qù Xīméndīng, qǐng dāchéng lánxiàn. Zhuǎnchéngzhàn kěyǐ huàn bùtóng de xiàn.

text_en: The Taipei MRT (Mass Rapid Transit) system covers most of Taipei City and the greater Taipei area, with multiple lines including the Red Line (Tamsui-Xinyi Line) and Blue Line (Bannan Line). The EasyCard can be used for both single and transferring rides. Passengers should exit from designated gates, and transfers between lines are free within one hour.

title: 台灣的超商文化
description: Explaining the importance and services of convenience stores in Taiwan.
text_zh: 在台灣，超商（如7-11和全家）非常多。你可以在那裡買食物、喝咖啡，還可以繳水電費、寄快遞和取包裹。很多人覺得超商是生活中不可缺少的一部分。有些超商還是24小時營業的，非常方便。
text_pinyin: Zài Táiwān, chāoshāng (rú qī-shí-yī hé Quánjiā) fēicháng duō. Nǐ kěyǐ zài nàlǐ mǎi shíwù, hē kāfēi, hái kěyǐ jiǎo shuǐdiànfèi, jì kuàidì hé qǔ bāoguǒ. Hěnduō rén juédé chāoshāng shì shēnghuó zhōng bùkě quēshǎo de yībùfèn. Yǒuxiē chāoshāng háishì èrshísì xiǎoshí yíngyè de, fēicháng fāngbiàn.

comprehension_questions.question: 超商除了買東西，還能做什麼？
為什麼超商很方便？

taiwan_context: Taiwan has the highest density of convenience stores in the world. They are essential for daily administrative tasks.
text_en: Taiwan's convenience stores, including 7-Eleven and FamilyMart, are open 24 hours a day. Besides buying snacks and drinks, you can also pay utility bills, ship packages, print documents, and use ATM services. Taiwan has a very high density of convenience stores, making them an indispensable part of daily life.

title: 新竹科學園區簡介
description: An introduction to the Hsinchu Science Park, the heart of Taiwan's tech industry.
text_zh: 新竹科學園區（竹科）成立於1980年，被稱為「台灣的矽谷」。這裡聚集了許多世界知名的半導體公司，如台積電和聯發科。數以萬計的工程師在這裡工作，推動了全球科技的發展。竹科不僅是工作的地方，周邊也有學校、公園和住宅區。
text_pinyin: Xīnzhú Kēxué Yuánqū (Zhúkē) chénglì yú yī-jiǔ-bā-líng nián, bèi chēng wéi 'Táiwān de Xīgǔ'. Zhèlǐ jùjí le xǔduō shìjiè zhīmíng de bàndǎotǐ gōngsī, rú Táijīdiàn hé Liánfākē. Shù yǐ wàn jì de gōngchéngshī zài zhèlǐ gōngzuò, tuīdòng le quánqiú kējì de fāzhǎn. Zhúkē bùjǐn shì gōngzuò de dìfāng, zhōubiān yěyǒu xuéxiào, gōngyuán hé zhùzháiqū.

comprehension_questions.question: 竹科被稱為什麼？
哪些公司在竹科？

taiwan_context: Hsinchu is the tech capital of Taiwan. Most expat engineers will live or work in this specific area.
text_en: Hsinchu Science Park, established in 1980, is known as 'Taiwan's Silicon Valley.' It houses hundreds of high-tech companies, including TSMC and UMC. The park focuses on semiconductor, computer, and optoelectronics industries, and is an important engine driving Taiwan's technological development. Many engineers from around the world work here.

title: 搭乘台灣高鐵
description: How to use the Taiwan High Speed Rail (THSR) to travel between cities.
text_zh: 台灣高鐵連接台北和高雄。從台北到新竹只需要半個小時，到台中一小時，到左營（高雄）只要一個半小時。你可以在網路、超商或車站買票。高鐵非常準時，環境也很乾淨，是出差和旅遊的首選。
text_pinyin: Táiwān Gāotiě liánjiē Táiběi hé Gāoxióng. Cóng Táiběi dào Xīnzhú zhǐ xūyào bàn gè xiǎoshí, dào Táizhōng yī xiǎoshí, dào Zuǒyíng (Gāoxióng) zhǐyào yīgè bàn xiǎoshí. Nǐ kěyǐ zài wǎnglù, chāoshāng huò chēzhàn mǎi piào. Gāotiě fēicháng zhǔnshí, huánjìng yě hěn gānjìng, shì chūchāi hé lǚyóu de shǒuxuǎn.

comprehension_questions.question: 從台北到新竹要多久？
在哪裡可以買高鐵票？

taiwan_context: The THSR is essential for tech workers commuting between Hsinchu and Taipei or visiting fab sites in Tainan.
text_en: Taiwan High Speed Rail (HSR) connects Taipei and Zuoying (Kaohsiung), with a total length of about 345 kilometers. The maximum speed is 300 kilometers per hour, and the journey from Taipei to Kaohsiung takes only about 90 minutes. Tickets can be purchased at stations or online. HSR has significantly shortened travel time in Taiwan and promotes economic development.

title: 如何點珍珠奶茶
description: Learning how to customize sugar and ice levels when ordering bubble tea.
text_zh: 在台灣點珍奶，你可以選甜度和冰塊。甜度有：全糖、半糖、微糖和無糖。冰塊有：正常冰、少冰、微冰和去冰。我通常喝微糖微冰，因為比較健康。
text_pinyin: Zài Táiwān diǎn zhēnnǎi, nǐ kěyǐ xuǎn tiándù hé bīngkuài. Tiándù yǒu: quántáng, bàntáng, wēitáng hé wútáng. Bīngkuài yǒu: zhèngcháng bīng, shǎobīng, wēibīng hé qùbīng. Wǒ tōngcháng hē wēitáng wēibīng, yīnwèi bǐjiào jiànkāng.

comprehension_questions.question: 哪一個甜度最不甜？
作者通常喝什麼樣的珍奶？

taiwan_context: Customizing drinks is a standard part of Taiwanese culture. Knowing these terms is essential for daily life.
text_en: Ordering bubble tea in Taiwan, you can customize according to your preferences. First choose the tea base, such as black tea, green tea, or milk tea. Then choose the sweetness level: no sugar, less sugar, half sugar, or full sugar. Ice level choices include no ice, less ice, regular ice, or extra ice. Finally choose toppings, such as tapioca pearls, pudding, or aloe.

title: 台灣的垃圾車
description: Explaining the unique trash disposal system in Taiwan with the music-playing trucks.
text_zh: 在台灣，垃圾車會播放音樂（如《給愛麗絲》）。聽到音樂時，大家會拿著垃圾袋到街上等車。垃圾要分類：一般垃圾、資源回收和廚餘。這種方式雖然有點麻煩，但能讓城市保持乾淨。
text_pinyin: Zài Táiwān, lājīchē huì bōfàng yīnyuè (rú 'Gěi Àilìsī'). Tīngdào yīnyuè shí, dàjiā huì názhe lājīdài dào jiēshàng děng chē. Lājī yào fēnlèi: yībān lājī, zīyuán huíshōu hé chúyú. Zhèzhǒng fāngshì suīrán yǒudiǎn máfan, dàn néng ràng chéngshì bǎochí gānjìng.

comprehension_questions.question: 垃圾車播放音樂時，大家要做什麼？
垃圾需要做什麼？

taiwan_context: The 'trash truck music' is one of the most iconic sounds of living in Taiwan. It's a key cultural ritual.
text_en: Taiwan's garbage trucks play a special music like 'Für Elise' when they arrive. Residents need to bring their trash out when they hear the music. Garbage must be sorted into general waste, recyclables, and food waste. Taiwan's garbage sorting system is very successful, with a recycling rate among the highest in the world. This system effectively reduces the amount of landfill waste.

title: 台積電（TSMC）簡介
description: A professional profile of the world's leading semiconductor foundry.
text_zh: 台灣積體電路製造公司（台積電）成立於1987年，總部位於新竹科學園區。它是全球最大的晶圓代工企業。台積電以先進的製程技術和高良率著稱，其客戶包括蘋果、英偉達等知名科技巨頭。在台灣，台積電被譽為「護國神山」，對經濟發展至關重要。
text_pinyin: Táiwān Jītǐ Diànlù Zhìzào Gōngsī (Táijīdiàn) chénglì yú yī-jiǔ-bā-qī nián, zǒngbù wèiyú Xīnzhú Kēxué Yuánqū. Tā shì quánqiú zuìdà de jīngyuán dàigōng qǐyè. Táijīdiàn yǐ xiānjìn de zhìchéng jìshù hé gāo liánglǜ zhùchēng, qí kèhù bāokuò Píngguǒ, Yīngwěidá děng zhīmíng kējì jùtóu. Zài Táiwān, Táijīdiàn bèi yù wéi 'hùguó shénshān', duì jīngjì fāzhǎn zhìguān zhòngyào.

comprehension_questions.question: 台積電的總部位於哪裡？
台積電在哪個領域是全球最大的？

taiwan_context: TSMC is the pride of Taiwan. Understanding its importance is key to integrating into the local tech community.
text_en: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC), founded in 1987 in Hsinchu Science Park, is the world's first and largest pure-play semiconductor foundry. TSMC's customers include Apple, NVIDIA, and AMD. TSMC has advanced manufacturing processes at 2nm and below, leading the world. TSMC's success has made Taiwan an indispensable hub in the global semiconductor supply chain.

title: 台灣的早餐文化
description: Introduction to common Taiwanese breakfast items.
text_zh: 台灣人很重視早餐。常見的早餐有蛋餅、飯糰、三明治和燒餅油條。飲料通常喝豆漿、米漿或奶茶。很多早餐店從早上五點就開始營業了。
text_pinyin: Táiwān rén hěn zhòngshì zǎocān. Chángjiàn de zǎocān yǒu dànbǐng, fàntuán, sānmíngzhì hé shāobǐng yóutiáo. Yǐnliào tōngcháng hē dòujiāng, mǐjiāng huò nǎichá. Hěnduō zǎocāndiàn cóng zǎoshàng wǔ diǎn jiù kāishǐ yíngyè le.

comprehension_questions.question: 哪一個是飲料？
早餐店通常幾點開始營業？

taiwan_context: Breakfast shops are a cornerstone of Taiwanese life. They are cheap, fast, and delicious.
text_en: Taiwanese breakfast culture is very distinctive. Traditional Taiwanese breakfast shops open as early as 5 or 6 AM, offering soy milk, fried dough sticks, rice rolls, egg pancakes, and sandwiches. Western-style breakfast shops offer toast, eggs, and coffee. Taiwanese people also often stop at convenience stores for quick breakfast. Breakfast is an important meal of the day for Taiwanese.

title: 台北101跨年煙火
description: The famous New Year's Eve fireworks at Taipei 101.
text_zh: 每年最後一天，台北101都會放煙火。成千上萬的人會聚集在市政府附近觀看。煙火表演非常壯觀，通常持續幾分鐘。大家一起倒數：五、四、三、二、一，新年快樂！
text_pinyin: Měinián zuìhòu yītiān, Táiběi yī-líng-yī dōu huì fàng yānhuǒ. Chéngqiānshàngwàn de rén huì jùjí zài shìzhèngfǔ fùjìn guānkàn. Yānhuǒ biǎoyǎn fēicháng zhuàngguān, tōngcháng chíxù jǐ fēnzhōng. Dàjiā yīqǐ dǎoshǔ: wǔ, sì, sān, èr, yī, xīnnián kuàilè!

Starting from midnight on the last day of the year, Taipei 101 launches fireworks in multiple waves, with colorful sparks blooming in the night sky. Hundreds of thousands of people gather around the building to watch this grand spectacle welcoming the New Year.

text_zh: 阿里山位於台灣嘉義縣，是台灣最著名的山區景點之一。每年春天，阿里山的櫻花盛開，吸引大批遊客前來觀賞。阿里山日出是必看的景色，清晨薄霧中，太陽從雲海之上緩緩升起，景象壯觀美麗。
text_pinyin: Ālǐshān wèiyú Táiwān Jiāyìxiàn, shì Táiwān zuì zhùmíng de shānqū jǐngdiǎn zhī yī. Měinián chūntiān, Ālǐshān de yīnghuā shèngkāi, xīyǐn dà pī yóukè qiánlái guānshǎng. Ālǐshān rìchū shì bìkàn de jǐngsè, qīngchén bówù zhōng, tàiyáng cóng yúnhǎi zhīshàng huǎnhuǎn shēngqǐ, jǐngxiàng zhuàngguān měilì.

The Alishan sunrise is a must-see; in the early morning mist, the sun slowly rises above the sea of clouds, creating a magnificent and beautiful scene.

text_pinyin: Jiǔfèn wèiyú Táiwān Xīnběishì, shì yī gè chōngmǎn lǎojiē fēngqíng de shānchéng xiǎozhèn. Xīrì yīn táojīn ér fánróng, rújīn yǐ hóngdēnglóng, shíjiē bùdào hé tèsè chálóu wénmíng. text_en: Jiufen is located in New Taipei City, Taiwan, and is a charming mountain town full of old street atmosphere. It was once prosperous due to gold mining; today it is famous for its red lanterns, stone step paths, and distinctive teahouses. At night, when the red lanterns light up, all of Jiufen looks especially enchanting, attracting countless domestic and international visitors.

title: 鼎泰豐小籠包
text_zh: 鼎泰豐是台灣著名的連鎖餐廳，以小籠包聞名全球。每一顆小籠包都有十八道褶，皮薄餡多，湯汁豐富。鼎泰豐在全世界都有分店，並曾多次獲得米其林星級評鑑，是許多外國遊客來台必訪的餐廳。
text_pinyin: Dǐngtàifēng shì Táiwān zhùmíng de liánsuǒ cāntīng, yǐ xiǎolóngbāo wénmíng quánqiú. Měi yī kē xiǎolóngbāo dōu yǒu shíbā dào zhě, pí báo xiàn duō, tāngzhī fēngfù. Dǐngtàifēng zài quán shìjiè dōu yǒu fēndiàn, bìng céng duōcì huòdé mǐqílín xīngjí píngjian, shì xǔduō wàiguó yóukè lái Tái bìfǎng de cāntīng.

Din Tai Fung has branches worldwide and has received multiple Michelin star ratings, making it a must-visit restaurant for many foreign tourists coming to Taiwan.

title: 台灣的健保
text_zh: 台灣的全民健康保險（健保）於一九九五年開始實施，是全球最完善的醫療保障制度之一。幾乎所有在台灣的居民都強制加入健保，保費由雇主、員工和政府共同分擔。民眾看病只需支付少量的部分負擔費用，即可在全國各地的醫院和診所就醫，有效減輕了民眾的醫療負擔。
text_pinyin: Táiwān de quánmín jiànkāng bǎoxiǎn jiànbǎo yú yījiǔjiǔwǔ nián kāishǐ shíshī, shì quánqiú zuì wánshàn de yīliáo bǎozhàng zhìdù zhī yī. Jīhū suǒyǒu zài Táiwān de jūmín dōu qiángzhì jiārù jiànbǎo, bǎofèi yóu gùzhǔ, yuángōng hé zhèngfǔ gòngtóng fēndān. Mínzhòng kàn bìng zhǐ xū zhīfù shǎoliàng de bùfèn fùdān fèiyòng, jí kě zài quánguó gèdì de yīyuàn hé zhěnsuǒ jiùyī, yǒuxiào jiǎnqīng le mínzhòng de yīliáo fùdān.

text_en: Taiwan's National Health Insurance (NHI) was implemented in 1995 and is one of the world's most comprehensive medical protection systems. Almost all residents in Taiwan are required to join the NHI; premiums are shared by employers, employees, and the government. People only need to pay a small co-payment to receive medical care at hospitals and clinics nationwide, effectively reducing residents' medical burden.

text_zh: 淡水位於台北近郊，是一個臨海的小城鎮。淡水的夕陽景色非常出名，每到傍晚，天空染上橙紅色的光芒，倒映在淡水河面上，美不勝收。老街上有許多特色小吃，如阿給和魚丸，是遊客必嚐的美食。
text_pinyin: Dànshuǐ wèiyú Táiběi jìnjiāo, shì yī gè lín hǎi de xiǎo chéngzhèn. Dànshuǐ de xīyáng jǐngsè fēicháng chūmíng, měi dào bàngwǎn, tiānkōng rǎnshàng chénghóng sè de guāngmáng, dàoyìng zài Dànshuǐ hé miàn shàng, měi bù shèng shōu. Lǎojiē shàng yǒu xǔduō tèsè xiǎochī, rú ā gěi hé yúwán, shì yóukè bì cháng de měishí.

text_en: Tamsui is located in the suburbs of Taipei and is a small coastal town. Tamsui's sunset scenery is very famous; every evening, the sky is dyed with orange-red light that reflects on the Tamsui River surface, creating a breathtakingly beautiful view. The old street has many specialty snacks, such as agei (stuffed tofu puff) and fish balls, which are must-try foods for tourists.

title: 中秋節烤肉
text_zh: 中秋節是台灣重要的傳統節日，每年農曆八月十五日慶祝。這一天，家人會團聚在一起賞月、吃月餅。台灣人還有一個獨特的中秋節習俗，就是在戶外烤肉。中秋節的夜晚，到處都能聞到烤肉的香味，非常熱鬧。
text_pinyin: Zhōngqiū jié shì Táiwān zhòngyào de chuántǒng jiérì, měinián nónglì bā yuè shíwǔ rì qìngzhù. Zhè yī tiān, jiārén huì tuánjù zài yīqǐ shǎng yuè, chī yuèbǐng. Táiwānyén hái yǒu yī gè dútè de Zhōngqiū jié xísú, jiùshì zài hùwài kǎoròu. Zhōngqiū jié de yèwǎn, dàochù dōu néng wén dào kǎoròu de xiāngwèi, fēicháng rènào.

On this day, family members gather to admire the moon and eat mooncakes. Taiwanese also have a unique Mid-Autumn Festival custom of outdoor BBQ. On Mid-Autumn Festival evening, the aroma of BBQ can be smelled everywhere, making it very lively.

title: 台南古蹟
text_zh: 台南是台灣最古老的城市，有超過三百年的歷史。這裡保存了許多珍貴的歷史古蹟，如赤崁樓、安平古堡和延平郡王祠。台南也以美食聞名，擔仔麵、虱目魚和蝦捲都是當地的特色料理。走訪台南，彷彿走入了台灣的歷史長廊。
text_pinyin: Táinán shì Táiwān zuì gǔlǎo de chéngshì, yǒu chāoguò sānbǎi nián de lìshǐ. Zhèlǐ bǎocún le xǔduō zhēnguì de lìshǐ gǔjī, rú Chìkǎnlóu, Ānpíng gǔbǎo hé Yánpíng Jùnwáng Cí. Táinán yě yǐ měishí wénmíng, dǎnzǎimiàn, shīmùyú hé xiājuǎn dōu shì dāngdì de tèsè liàolǐ. Zǒufǎng Táinán, fǎngfú zǒu rù le Táiwān de lìshǐ chángláng.

text_en: Tainan is Taiwan's oldest city with over 300 years of history. Many precious historical sites are preserved here, such as Chihkan Tower, Anping Fort, and the Koxinga Shrine. Tainan is also famous for its food; danzai noodles, milkfish, and shrimp rolls are all local specialty dishes. Visiting Tainan is like walking through the historical corridor of Taiwan.

title: 半導體產業優勢
text_zh: 台灣的半導體產業在全球佔有舉足輕重的地位。台灣積體電路製造公司（台積電）是全球最大的晶圓代工廠，生產全球超過半數的先進晶片。台灣半導體產業的成功，得益於政府的大力支持、完整的供應鏈以及大量優秀的工程師人才。台灣被稱為「晶片之島」，對全球科技發展有深遠影響。
text_pinyin: Táiwān de bàndǎotǐ chǎnyè zài quánqiú zhànyǒu jǔzúqīngzhòng de dìwèi. Táiwān jī tǐ diànlù zhìzào gōngsī Táijīdiàn shì quánqiú zuìdà de jīngyuán dàigōng chǎng, shēngchǎn quánqiú chāoguò bànshù de xiānjìn jīnpiàn. Táiwān bàndǎotǐ chǎnyè de chénggōng, déyì yú zhèngfǔ de dàlì zhīchí, wánzhěng de gōngyìng liàn yǐjí dàliàng yōuxiù de gōngchéngshī réncái. The success of Taiwan's semiconductor industry is attributed to strong government support, a complete supply chain, and a large pool of excellent engineering talent. Taiwan is known as the 'Island of Chips' and has a profound influence on global technology development.

Měiguāng Táiwān de qǐyè wénhuà qiángdiào chuàngxīn, hézuò yǔ duōyuán, gǔlì yuángōng tíchū xīn xiǎngfǎ bìng jījí cānyù tuánduì zhuān'àn. text_zh: 在台灣的職場上，有一些重要的禮儀需要遵守。見到長輩或上司時，應主動問候並使用敬語。開會時要守時，事先準備好資料。與同事相處要友善，遇到問題可以尋求協助。下班後，台灣的職場文化也常有聚餐等社交活動，這是增進同事感情的好機會。
text_pinyin: Zài Táiwān de zhíchǎng shàng, yǒu yīxiē zhòngyào de lǐyí xūyào zūnshǒu. Jiàn dào zhǎngbèi huò shàngsī shí, yīng zhǔdòng wènhòu bìng shǐyòng jìngyǔ. Kāihuì shí yào shǒushí, shìxiān zhǔnbèi hǎo zīliào. Yǔ tóngshì xiāngchǔ yào yǒushàn, yù dào wèntí kěyǐ xúnqiú xiézhù. Xià bān hòu, Táiwān de zhíchǎng wénhuà yě cháng yǒu jùcān děng shèjiāo huódòng, zhè shì zēngjìn tóngshì gǎnqíng de hǎo jīhuì.

text_en: In Taiwan's workplace, there are some important etiquette rules to follow. When meeting elders or supervisors, you should proactively greet them and use respectful language. Be punctual for meetings and prepare materials in advance. Be friendly with colleagues; if you encounter problems, you can seek help. After work, Taiwan's workplace culture often includes social activities like group meals, which are good opportunities to strengthen relationships with colleagues.

title: 面試技巧
text_zh: 面試是求職過程中的關鍵環節。準備面試時，應事先研究目標公司的背景、文化和主要業務。面試當天要穿著整齊，提前到達，展現積極的態度。面試中要清楚表達自己的能力和經驗，並展示對這份工作的熱情。面試結束後，可以寫一封感謝信，加深面試官的良好印象。
text_pinyin: Miànshì shì qiúzhí guòchéng zhōng de guānjiàn huánjié. Zhǔnbèi miànshì shí, yīng shìxiān yánjiū mùbiāo gōngsī de bèijǐng, wénhuà hé zhǔyào yèwù. Miànshì jiéshù hòu, kěyǐ xiě yī fēng gǎnxiè xìn, jiāshēn miànshìguān de liánghǎo yìnxiàng.

title: 台北故宮
text_zh: 國立故宮博物院位於台北士林區，是世界頂級的博物館之一，收藏超過七十萬件中華文物。博物館的鎮館之寶包括翠玉白菜、肉形石和毛公鼎。這些珍貴的文物來自中國數千年的歷史，是了解中華文化的重要窗口。每年有數百萬名遊客來此參觀。
text_pinyin: Guólì gùgōng bówùyuàn wèiyú Táiběi Shìlínqū, shì shìjiè dǐngjí de bówùguǎn zhī yī, shōucáng chāoguò qīshí wàn jiàn Zhōnghuá wénwù. Bówùguǎn de zhèn guǎn zhī bǎo bāokuò cuìyù báicài, ròuxíngshí hé máogōngdǐng. Zhèxiē zhēnguì de wénwù láizì Zhōngguó shùqiān nián de lìshǐ, shì liǎojiě Zhōnghuá wénhuà de zhòngyào chuāngkǒu. text_en: The National Palace Museum is located in Shilin District, Taipei, and is one of the world's top museums, housing over 700,000 pieces of Chinese cultural artifacts. The museum's treasured masterpieces include the Jadeite Cabbage, Meat-Shaped Stone, and Mao Gong Ding. These precious artifacts spanning thousands of years of Chinese history are an important window for understanding Chinese culture. Millions of tourists visit each year.

title: 台式熱炒
text_zh: 台式熱炒是台灣非常普遍的飲食文化。熱炒店通常在傍晚開始營業，提供各種用大火快炒的料理，如炒空心菜、薑母鴨、三杯雞等。價格實惠，份量十足，深受台灣人喜愛。朋友聚餐或下班後小酌，熱炒店是最受歡迎的選擇之一。

Jiàgé shíhuì, fèn liàng shí zú, shēn shòu Táiwānyén xǐài. Péngyǒu jùcān huò xià bān hòu xiǎo zhuó, rè chǎo diàn shì zuì shòu huānyíng de xuǎnzé zhī yī.

text_en: Taiwanese stir-fry (rechao) is a very common dining culture in Taiwan. Rechao restaurants typically start operating in the evening and offer various dishes cooked with high-heat stir-frying, such as stir-fried water spinach, sesame ginger duck, and three-cup chicken. The prices are affordable, portions are generous, and they are well-loved by Taiwanese people. Rechao restaurants are one of the most popular choices for friend gatherings or after-work drinks.

title: 台灣的颱風
text_zh: 台灣因為地理位置特殊，每年都會受到颱風影響，通常在五月到十一月之間。颱風帶來強風和豪雨，可能造成洪水、土石流等災害。台灣政府建立了完善的颱風預警系統，當颱風來臨時，政府會宣布停班停課，提醒民眾避免外出，做好防颱準備。台灣人已學會與颱風共存。

Táifēng dài lái qiáng fēng hé háoyǔ, kěnéng zàochéng hóngshuǐ, tǔshíliú děng zāihài. Táiwān zhèngfǔ jiànlì le wánshàn de táifēng yùjǐng xìtǒng, dāng táifēng láilín shí, zhèngfǔ huì xuānbù tíng bān tíng kè, tíxǐng mínzhòng bìmiǎn wàichū, zuòhǎo fáng tái zhǔnbèi. Táiwānyén yǐ xuéhuì yǔ táifēng gòngcún.

text_en: Due to its special geographical location, Taiwan is affected by typhoons every year, usually between May and November. Typhoons bring strong winds and heavy rain that can cause floods, mudslides, and other disasters. The Taiwan government has established a comprehensive typhoon warning system; when a typhoon approaches, the government will announce cancellation of work and school, reminding people to avoid going out and prepare for typhoon protection. Taiwanese people have learned to coexist with typhoons.

title: 夜市小吃
text_zh: 台灣夜市是小吃天堂。常見的夜市小吃有臭豆腐、蚵仔煎、大腸包小腸、滷味和珍珠奶茶。夜市通常在傍晚開始熱鬧，一直到深夜。台灣各地都有不同特色的夜市，是體驗台灣飲食文化的最好方式。

Night markets typically become lively from evening until late night. Different areas of Taiwan have night markets with unique characteristics; they are the best way to experience Taiwan's food culture.

title: 如何搭公車
text_zh: 在台灣搭公車很方便。首先要找到公車站牌，確認路線號碼。上車時，可以使用悠遊卡感應，或者準備零錢投幣。台灣的公車通常有電子看板顯示下一站資訊。需要下車時，要提前按鈴通知司機。下車時再次感應悠遊卡，部分路線需在下車時補付費用。

Taiwan's buses usually have electronic displays showing the next stop information. When you need to get off, press the bell in advance to notify the driver. Tap your EasyCard again when getting off; some routes require additional payment upon exit.

title: 龍山寺拜拜
text_zh: 龍山寺位於台北萬華區，是台灣最著名的佛道教廟宇之一，建於一七三八年。廟內供奉觀世音菩薩和多位神明，每日有眾多信徒前來燒香祈福。龍山寺的建築融合了閩南式和巴洛克式風格，精美的雕刻和裝飾令人嘆為觀止，是外國遊客必訪的文化景點。
text_pinyin: Lóngshānsì wèiyú Táiběi Wànhuáqū, shì Táiwān zuì zhùmíng de fó dàojiào miàoyǔ zhī yī, jiànyú yī qī sān bā nián. Miào nèi gòngfèng Guānshìyīn púsà hé duō wèi shénmíng, měi rì yǒu zhòngduō xìntú qiánlái shāo xiāng qífú. Lóngshānsì de jiànzhù rónghé le Mǐnnán shì hé bāluòkè shì fēnggé, jīngměi de diāokè hé zhuāngshì lìng rén tànwéi guānzhǐ, shì wàiguó yóukè bìfǎng de wénhuà jǐngdiǎn.

text_en: Longshan Temple is located in Wanhua District, Taipei, and is one of Taiwan's most famous Buddhist and Taoist temples, built in 1738. The temple enshrines Guanyin Bodhisattva and many other deities; many worshippers come daily to burn incense and pray for blessings. Longshan Temple's architecture blends Southern Min and Baroque styles; the exquisite carvings and decorations are breathtaking, making it a cultural attraction that foreign tourists must visit.

title: 墾丁海灘
text_zh: 墾丁位於台灣最南端的屏東縣，是著名的熱帶海濱度假勝地。這裡有清澈的海水、白沙灘和豐富的珊瑚礁生態，是浮潛和水上活動的天堂。墾丁國家公園擁有多樣的自然景觀，全年氣候溫暖，是台灣人最喜愛的度假目的地之一。
text_pinyin: Kěndīng wèiyú Táiwān zuì nán duān de Píngdōng xiàn, shì zhùmíng de rèdài hǎibīn dùjià shèngdì. Zhèlǐ yǒu qīngchè de hǎishuǐ, bái shā tān hé fēngfù de shānhújiāo shēngtài, shì fúqián hé shuǐshàng huódòng de tiāntáng. Kěndīng guójiā gōngyuán yǒngyǒu duōyàng de zìrán jǐngguān, quánnián qìhòu wēnnuǎn, shì Táiwānyén zuì xǐài de dùjià mùdìdì zhī yī.

It has clear waters, white sandy beaches, and rich coral reef ecosystems, making it a paradise for snorkeling and water activities. Kenting National Park has diverse natural landscapes, and the climate is warm year-round, making it one of the most beloved vacation destinations for Taiwanese people.

title: 太魯閣國家公園
text_zh: 太魯閣國家公園位於台灣東部，是台灣最著名的自然景觀之一。公園以壯麗的大理石峽谷聞名，清水斷崖高達數百公尺，令人驚嘆。立霧溪穿越峽谷，形成了獨特的地質景觀。太魯閣也是許多原住民族的傳統領地，擁有豐富的自然和文化資產，每年吸引數百萬遊客到訪。
text_pinyin: Tài lǔ gé guójiā gōngyuán wèiyú Táiwān dōngbù, shì Táiwān zuì zhùmíng de zìrán jǐngguān zhī yī. Tài lǔ gé yě shì xǔduō yuánzhùmínzú de chuántǒng lǐngdì, yǒngyǒu fēngfù de zìrán hé wénhuà zīchǎn, měinián xīyǐn shùbǎi wàn yóukè dàofǎng.

text_en: Taroko National Park is located in eastern Taiwan and is one of Taiwan's most famous natural landscapes. The park is famous for its magnificent marble gorges; Qingshui Cliff rises hundreds of meters, inspiring awe. The Liwu River runs through the gorge, forming unique geological landscapes. Taroko is also the traditional territory of many indigenous peoples and has abundant natural and cultural assets; millions of tourists visit each year.

text_zh: 南寮漁港位於新竹市西北部，是新竹最主要的漁港。漁港附近有海景步道，可以欣賞台灣海峽的風光。清晨時分，漁船歸港，帶來新鮮的海鮮。附近的餐廳提供各式海鮮料理，是新竹人周末出遊的好去處。

Nearby restaurants offer various seafood dishes, making it a popular weekend outing destination for Hsinchu residents.
